source: Ilja, 2026-11-19: functional, multi-joint work. The base is pulling yourself up, pressing something away — dips, a kettlebell pressed overhead, a thruster — and the goblet squat. Everything else complements. A single link (triceps, biceps, calves) is not measured. Conditioning such as burpees is endurance and belongs to the AMRAP circuit, which he runs only when there is no basketball for a long time.
credit: A completed set counts ONCE for the pillar of its movement. No fractional credit by muscle, and no double credit for a combination lift.
rules: A lift that pulls and presses at once — a snatch, a clean and press — counts once, in the axis where it usually fails: the lockout overhead, so push. The catalogue marks it `power`.
`role` in the catalogue separates the base from what completes it: a base set and a support set both count, but the plan and the suggestions name the base first.
